claims.claim: USS Plunger (SS-2) was classified as an Adder Class Submarine Torpedo Boat.
USS Plunger (SS-2) featured single hull construction with the pressure hull wrapped around frames and internal tankage.
USS Plunger (SS-2) was powered by an Otto Gas Engine Works gasoline engine and Electro Dynamic electric motors driving a single screw.
USS Plunger (SS-2) ran test dives and conducted experimental work on machinery, armaments, and tactics at Newport and Provincetown.
USS Plunger (SS-2) trained her own crew and crews of other submarines nearing completion.
President Theodore Roosevelt made a test dive aboard USS Plunger (SS-2) on 25 March 1905.
USS Plunger (SS-2) was authorized as an experimental target designated Target E on 29 August 1916.
USS Plunger (SS-2) was sold for scrapping on 26 January 1922.
USS Plunger (SS-2) was armed with one 18-inch torpedo tube and carried 5 torpedoes.
USS Plunger (SS-2) was renamed USS A-1 (Submarine Torpedo Boat No.2) on 17 November 1911.
